derived_results.claim: For fixed distinct Gaussian P,Q, a threshold-dependent rolling start bank can remove history-length growth entirely while asymptotically preserving the optimal local block start.
derived_results.derivation: Let L=log A and choose h_A=sqrt(log(max(e,L))) so h_A->infinity slowly. Start one local point-null process every g_A=floor(L/h_A) observations and retain it for H_A=ceil(L h_A) observations. At any time at most H_A/g_A+O(1)=O(h_A^2)=O(log L)=O(log log A) local starts are active, independent of elapsed history t. For any fixed information I=D_KL(Q||P)>0, the target post-change evidence length d_A=(1+epsilon)L/I satisfies d_A/H_A->0, while the delay to the first scheduled start after T is at most g_A=o(d_A). Thus there is always an active pure-post-change start whose completion time is T+d_A+o(d_A).

derived_results.claim: The same rolling bank contains an explicit infinite disjoint retry subsequence at the unknown optimal delay scale, so the r63 geometric expectation argument does not require an O(log t) multiscale family.
derived_results.derivation: After the first scheduled start s_1 in (T,T+g_A], define m_A=ceil(d_A/g_A)g_A and choose retry starts s_j=s_1+(j-1)m_A; every s_j belongs to the start grid and successive length-d_A evidence blocks are disjoint because m_A>=d_A. Each start remains alive through its block since H_A/d_A=I h_A/(1+epsilon)->infinity. Under iid Q the block-success events used in the proof are therefore independent, and r63c gives failure p_A<=C A^{-kappa}. The expected retry multiplier is 1/(1-p_A)=1+o(1).

derived_results.claim: A permanent raw start-1 prefix can replace the nonconvex adjusted prefix in the sparse computational channel, because only an exponentially unlikely number of retries can contaminate enough of the long prefix to erase exterior evidence.
derived_results.derivation: At T the start-1 SNML prefix rejects R outside U with failure exp(-cT) by r63d. By continuity of Gaussian mixture moments there exists a fixed rho=rho(P,Q,U)>0 such that adding at most rho T post-change Q observations keeps the expected/empirical Gaussian fit in a smaller neighborhood of P with exponentially high probability, so exterior KL separation remains positive. The number of disjoint failed local retries required to exceed rho T post observations is N_A>=rho T/d_A. Since retry failure is at most p_A<=A^{-kappa}, P(N>N_A)<=p_A^{N_A}=exp(-Omega(T)). Hence the raw prefix remains adequate on the entire typical retry path; the bounded backup from r63 controls the exponentially rare complement. This keeps the prefix/local pair in the centered scalar-dual form, unlike a running-max adjuster.

derived_results.claim: Monitoring only pair certificates between the permanent prefix and active rolling starts is false-alarm safe because each pair statistic is a pathwise lower surrogate of the source all-start Gaussian e-detector.
derived_results.derivation: For any active start s and candidate R, max{L^R_{1:t},L^R_{s:t}}<=sum_{u<=t}L^R_{u:t}. Taking inf_R preserves the inequality. Therefore C_{s,t}:=inf_R max{L^R_{1:t},L^R_{s:t}} is no larger than the valid all-start composite detector D_t. Taking max over the retained starts also stays <=D_t because every C_{s,t} is bounded by the same D_t. A stopping rule that thresholds this sparse maximum cannot stop earlier than the valid all-start rule, so it inherits its ARL false-alarm safety without assigning extra start weights or paying log T penalties.

derived_results.claim: The resulting sparse production channel has threshold-polylogarithmic, history-independent state and near-first-order delay for every fixed P,Q.
derived_results.derivation: With h_A=sqrt(log L), active local starts are O(log L)=O(log log A). Each start needs O(1) centered sufficient statistics and universal-predictor state. The r60 certified scalar pair optimization needs O(log L)=O(log log A) lambda evaluations in its conservative asymptotic bound, so evaluating every active pair from cold brackets costs O((log log A)^2) scalar work per monitoring time; r62 warm starts suggest a lower average. Detection delay is d_A+g_A times a 1+o(1) retry multiplier, so relative to L/I the start-spacing penalty is I/h_A=o(1). State no longer grows with t, unlike O(t), O(log t), or recycled history grids.

derived_results.claim: The deterministic-cap backup can be combined without sacrificing sparse validity by averaging it with the unavailable-but-valid full detector and thresholding only a computable lower surrogate.
derived_results.derivation: Let D_full be the valid all-start Gaussian composite e-detector and B the bounded-transform backup e-detector. Their average E=(D_full+B)/2 is an e-detector. The computable sparse statistic E_sparse=(C_sparse+B)/2 satisfies E_sparse<=E pathwise because C_sparse<=D_full. Therefore thresholding E_sparse at A is ARL-safe. Main Gaussian evidence need only reach 2A, adding log 2=o(log A), while B reaching 2A forces a deterministic O(A^2) pathwise stop and supplies the r63 rare-event tail cap.

candidates_new.mechanism: Permanent Cauchy-initialized SNML prefix plus a rolling local start bank with spacing log(A)/sqrt(log log A), lifetime log(A)*sqrt(log log A), centered scalar pair certificates, and a bounded-transform backup channel.
candidates_new.quantitative_or_formal_evidence: Only O(log log A) active starts; conservative cold pair scoring O((log log A)^2) scalar evaluations per monitoring time; start alignment contributes o(log A) delay for every fixed P,Q; disjoint retry starts are embedded in the same grid; sparse statistic is a pathwise lower surrogate of the source all-start detector.
candidates_new.scope: Derived asymptotic architecture for fixed distinct one-dimensional Gaussian P,Q under late-change ARL. The concentration/retry proof still needs full formal write-up and numerical end-to-end validation.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: A geometric multiscale bank with O(log t) active starts is necessary to handle unknown information scale.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: Not necessary in the fixed-P,Q asymptotic. Threshold-scaled start spacing g=o(log A) and lifetime H/log A->infinity cover every fixed d~log A/I while keeping O(log log A) state.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.reason: Prefer the simpler rolling bank unless uniformity over I varying with A is required.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: A running-max adjuster is mandatory for the production prefix.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: Not for the derived late-change sparse channel if raw prefix contamination is controlled through geometric retry tails and a bounded backup. The adjuster remains the cleaner generic proof tool.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.reason: Raw prefix preserves scalar-dual convex computation; keep adjuster as fallback/theory reference.

frontier: Formalize the raw-prefix mixed P/Q concentration uniformly over retry endpoints up to rho T and prove the exp(-Omega(T)) bound used in r64c.

Implement the threshold-scaled rolling start bank with Cauchy-initialized SNML and centered pair scoring; compare empirical delay and operations against exact all-start Newton and recycled K-grid baselines.
Replace cold scalar brackets with safe warm brackets plus tangent fallback and measure whether per-time work falls from O((log log A)^2) toward O(log log A).
Study uniformity when information I=I_A may vanish or diverge with A; the current history-independent state result is pointwise for fixed P,Q.
Check whether a different h_A tradeoff improves state-vs-alignment, e.g. h_A=(log log A)^gamma, and derive the Pareto curve.

actions_taken_instead_of_stopping: Replaced the planned O(log t) multiscale retry bank with a simpler threshold-scaled rolling bank.
Embedded provably disjoint retry blocks for every fixed information scale without knowing that scale.
Recovered raw-prefix scalar-dual computability by showing only exponentially unlikely retry counts threaten pre-change dominance.
Established a pathwise lower-surrogate argument that preserves false-alarm validity without extra start weights.
Reduced active start state to O(log log A), independent of history length.

exact_next_action: Implement and stress-test the r64 history-independent rolling bank end-to-end, while formalizing the mixed-prefix concentration bound that turns its current CADD proof architecture into a complete theorem for fixed Gaussian P,Q.
